entry.title: MIDI Transport 1.0.1
entry.summary: Repackages MIDI Transport with Open MPC’s current installer and uninstaller. The release declares the MPC Remote add-in dependency, and the README identifies the hardware-tested build. The release includes ARMv7, AArch64, and manual-install SDK ZIPs. The original MPC X hardware results are documented for [version 1.0.0](https://github.com/shhQuiet/MPCMidiTransport/blob/v1.0.0/docs/release-testing-1.0.0.md). For this packaging update, the native VST smoke test and catalog validation passed.

entry.title: MIDI Transport 1.0.0
entry.summary: # MIDI Transport 1.0.0 Map MIDI notes and CCs to MPC transport and hardware buttons. Add mapping rows on the **CONTROL** page, choose an action, and tap **Learn**. Each row supports Momentary and Toggle controller behavior. Save the MPC project to keep your mappings. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1 or later, External Plugin Support, and [Open MPC Remote](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-remote) listening on local port 6720.
